name: Daisy Disable Blocks — Disable Gutenberg, Enable Classic Editor, Disable Block Editor
author: DaisyPlugins

sections.description:
Daisy Disable Blocks is the ultimate solution for WordPress users who prefer the classic editing experience. This plugin allows you to:

  • Completely disable Gutenberg block editor
  • Restore the classic TinyMCE editor
  • Bring back traditional meta boxes
  • Disable block widgets and patterns
  • Control fullscreen mode

With an intuitive, colorful interface, you can easily toggle these features on/off with simple switches.

Key Features

✔ Disable Gutenberg block editor completely
✔ Restore classic TinyMCE editor
✔ Bring back traditional meta boxes
✔ Disable block widgets screen
✔ Remove block patterns
✔ Control editor fullscreen mode
✔ Responsive, user-friendly interface
✔ 100% free with no upsells

Additional Information

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the WordPress support forum.

If you enjoy this plugin, please consider leaving a review. Your feedback helps improve the plugin!

Credits

Developed with ❤ by DaisyPlugins
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/daisy-disable-blocks directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings → Daisy Blocks to configure your preferences
sections.faq:
Will this work with my current posts?

Yes! All your existing content will remain exactly as it was. The plugin only changes the editing interface.

Can I disable blocks for specific post types?

Currently, the plugin disables blocks globally. Future versions may include post-type specific controls.

Will this affect my widgets?

Only if you enable the “Disable Block Widgets” option, which will restore the classic widgets interface.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Daisy Disable Blocks works with all properly coded WordPress themes. If your theme heavily relies on block editor features, some functionality may be limited.
